inputs.prose: A research system records measurements and preserves evidence. The observatory studies how memory, computation, and numerical precision affect attention. Every experiment has a fixed input and a reproducible protocol.

sampling: exploratory deterministic repeated public prose/code; not independent dataset population
precision_controls: explicit FP32 OPT/7B conditions; BF16 results kept separately
intervention: all-layer INT4 group32 decode only; native prefill; teacher-forced full native tokens; dense KV caches retained

continuations.prose: The next measurement is recorded before the configuration changes. Each result is checked against the reference and saved with its input.

teacher_forcing: externally authored continuation IDs, identical across every variant and dtype
regimes: isolated native cache snapshot at each step
recurrent intervention from identical initial cache
factorial: K 0/1 x V 0/1; INT4 group32 eager; no-op, layer, bit/group, backend and packing controls
dtype_interpretation: same pretrained checkpoint cast to BF16/FP32; same frozen token IDs; TF32 off in both; no runtime comparison
